title: 5S - How it helps
prompt: How does the 5S method help the workplace?
hint: Think of sorting, setting in order, cleaning, standardizing, and sustaining.

ja.hint: 整理、整頓、清掃、標準化、維持の5つのステップを考えてください。

title: Kaizen - Employee involvement
prompt: What does Kaizen encourage frontline employees to do?
hint: They are encouraged to suggest small changes because they directly experience problems.
sample: Suggest small improvements because they see problems.

ja.prompt: カイゼンは現場の従業員に何を促しますか？
ja.hint: 現場の人は問題に直面しているため、小さな改善案を出すことが奨励されます。
ja.sample: 小さな改善を提案することです。

local.prompt: What does Kaizen encourage frontline employees to do?
local.hint: They are encouraged to suggest small changes because they directly experience problems.
local.sample: Suggest small improvements because they see problems.

local_pron.prompt: wʌt dʌz kaɪˈzɛn ɛnˈkʌrɪdʒ ˈfrʌntlaɪn ɛmˈplɔɪiːz tuː duː?
local_pron.hint: ðeɪ ɑːr ɛnˈkʌrɪdʒd tuː səˈdʒɛst smɔːl ʧeɪnʤɪz bɪˈkɔːz ðeɪ dɪˈrɛktli ɪkˈspɪəriəns ˈprɒbləmz.
local_pron.sample: səˈdʒɛst smɔːl ɪmˈpruːvmənts bɪˈkɔːz ðeɪ siː ˈprɒbləmz.

zh.prompt: 改善（Kaizen）鼓勵前線員工做什麼？
zh.hint: 因為他們直接面對問題，所以鼓勵他們提出小的改進建議。
zh.sample: 提出小的改進，因為他們看到問題。

en.prompt: What does Kaizen encourage frontline employees to do?
en.hint: They are encouraged to suggest small changes because they directly experience problems.
en.sample: Suggest small improvements because they see problems.

en_pron.prompt: What does Kaizen encourage frontline employees to do?
en_pron.hint: They are encouraged to suggest small changes because they directly experience problems.
